blocks.h2: What a Maintenance Visit Can (and Can't) Fix
blocks.intro: A maintenance visit is built around prevention, not repair. Here's where the line falls:
head: Included in a Maintenance Visit
Needs a Different Service
rows: A camera inspection to check your line's current condition
An active sewage backup. Likely fix: [Emergency Plumbing](/mokena/emergency-plumbing)
Catching early root growth or wear before it becomes a bigger problem
A cracked or collapsed pipe. Likely fix: [Sewer Repair](/mokena/sewer-repair)
A light interior clean as part of the visit
A heavy clog that needs full clearing. Likely fix: [Sewer Rodding](/mokena/sewer-rodding) or [Hydro Jetting](/mokena/hydro-jetting)
An honest assessment of what your line needs next
A line at the end of its lifespan. Likely fix: [Trenchless Sewer Repair](/mokena/trenchless-sewer-repair)
blocks.note: If your line needs more than a checkup, we'll tell you exactly what and why. No surprise upsells.

blocks.h2: Sewer Maintenance Questions From Mokena Homeowners

items.q: Does a newer home need sewer maintenance?
items.preview: Only if it's had a problem.
items.answer: Not on a schedule unless the line has a sag, roots or a history of clogs. A camera check every few years is enough for a line that's working.

items.q: What time of year is best for sewer maintenance?
items.answer: Late winter or early spring, before roots start growing and before the summer storms.

items.q: Can maintenance prevent a storm backup?
items.preview: It helps your line drain, but protection does more.
items.answer: A clean line drains faster. If the village sewer is overloaded in a storm, you need a backflow valve or an [overhead sewer](/mokena/overhead-sewer-systems).

items.q: Is sewer maintenance part of the No Drip Club?
items.preview: The club includes regular maintenance visits.
items.answer: The [No Drip Club](/no-drip-club) brings a plumber to your home for regular maintenance. Ask how it applies to your sewer line.

items.q: How much does sewer maintenance cost in Mokena?
items.preview: It depends on the service. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on whether your line needs rodding, jetting or a camera check. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
